formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p17_t2_recursive_sum_bias_condition_bound {n : Nat} (a factor : Fin n -> Real) (gamma : Real) (hsum : p17ExactSum a != 0) (hfactor : forall i, abs (factor i - 1) <= gamma) : abs (p17EffectiveExpectedSum a factor - p17ExactSum a) / abs (p17ExactSum a) <= gamma * p17SummationCondition a
formal_statement.plain_language: Coefficientwise bounds on expected suffix-product factors imply the summation-bias bound gamma times the summation condition number.

informal_proof: Rewrite each effective term as the original input plus a componentwise perturbation a_i(factor_i-1), bound that perturbation by gamma times |a_i|, apply the summation condition-number theorem, and divide by the nonzero exact sum.
informal_statement: Exact coefficientwise condition-number step in the proof of Theorem 4.1, before instantiating gamma with gamma_{n-1}(u_{p+r}).
